{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the full series to ensure all values are explicitly shown
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Extract the species with the highest mean
species_with_highest_mean = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print the result
print(f'Species with highest mean flipper length: {species_with_highest_mean}')"}
